definitions.gloss: award ceremony; commendation ceremony; prize-giving ceremony
definitions.explanation: A formal event where awards, prizes, or commendations are given to recognize achievement. Common in sports, academics, and workplaces.

examples.japanese: {表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}する。
{表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}で{金|きん}メダルを{授与|じゅよ}された。
examples.english: A gold medal was awarded at the ceremony.

examples.japanese: {大会|たいかい}の{最後|さいご}に{表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}が{行|おこな}われ、{優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}にトロフィーが{贈|おく}られた。
examples.english: An award ceremony was held at the end of the tournament, and the champion was presented with a trophy.

notes:
A compound of {表彰|ひょうしょう} (commendation, public recognition) and {式|しき} (ceremony). {表彰|ひょうしょう} itself combines {表|ひょう} (express, show) and {彰|しょう} (make clear, praise).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}を{行|おこな}う — to hold an award ceremony
- {表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}する — to attend an award ceremony
- {表彰|ひょうしょう}{台|だい} — award podium
- {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう} — certificate of commendation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {授賞式|じゅしょうしき} — prize-giving ceremony (specifically for prizes)
- {卒業式|そつぎょうしき} — graduation ceremony
- {式典|しきてん} — ceremony (more general, formal)
